content: Official Apple and Google Play publishing pages were fetched on 2026-10-20. Native app distribution requires store-specific submission and platform account workflows; Google Play policy says account-creating apps must provide an in-app account deletion path and a web resource, deleting the account and associated user data. Treat current policy as a plan constraint and resolve how shared recipes are handled under D-10 before selecting account architecture. Sources: developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/; support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/13327111?hl=en; developer.apple.com/help/app-review/guideline-reference/5-1-1-account-deletion
